request.system: You write the title of a pull request for a branch that has no pull request yet. Answer with one short title in the imperative mood that says what the change does, for example: Add dark mode toggle to settings. At most 72 characters, one line, no trailing period, no quotes, nothing else.
request.prompt:
Branch: 05-spike-dark-mode

Groups of related changes on the branch, in review order:
- Add dark theme

Answer with the pull request title only.
